en.healthIntro: DSH silently ignores a skill file it cannot read: it never appears in the catalog and nothing reports an error. This scans the skill roots directly to find them. Global roots only (user-dsh and user-agents); project-level skills are never touched.
en.healthIntro0_3: 0.3.0 ships the install/upgrade chain; skill health checks and auto-quarantine arrive in 0.4.0.
en.healthNeedRehearsal: Press Rehearse once to see exactly what would move, then switch it on.
en.healthNoFindings: No skill DSH cannot read was found.
en.healthRehearsalDone: Rehearsal complete: {0} would be quarantined, nothing was changed.
en.healthRestoreHint: Quarantined items can be restored from the Quarantine tab.
en.intro: Overview of every skill DSH resolves, plus search-and-install from skills.sh and safe upgrades. Uninstalling only moves a directory into quarantine — no file is deleted, no SKILL.md is ever rewritten.
en.quarantineMissing: The quarantined item is gone; it cannot be restored
en.rateLimit: GitHub API is rate limited, so update checks may be incomplete (set GITHUB_TOKEN to improve).

en.settingsIoHint: Export the current install baselines, quarantine ledger and switches; importing replaces the whole ledger (records only — no skill file is ever deleted).
